# Extend RIGHT to reach Blue block at cols 42-45
# Path currently at col ~16, need to reach col 42

    c_min, c_max = min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b)
    if n['color'] in ['M', 'R', 'b', 'N'] and r_min < 50:
        print(f"  {n['color']}: rows {r_min}-{r_max}, cols {c_min}-{c_max}")

# Check path
max_col = 0
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['w', 'g']:
        b = n['boundary']
        c_max = max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c_max > max_col:
            max_col = c_max
print(f"Path max col: {max_col}")
</parameter>
